env sumdb=$GKSUMDB
env proxy=$GKPROXY
env GKPRIVATE GKPROXY GKNOPROXY GKSUMDB GKNOSUMDB
env dbname=localhost.localdev/sumdb

# disagree with sumdb fails
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env GKSUMDB=$sumdb' '$proxy/sumdb-wrong
! go get rsc.io/quote
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR'

# GKNOSUMDB bypasses sumdb, for rsc.io/quote, rsc.io/sampler, golang.org/x/text
env GKNOSUMDB='*/quote,*/*mple*,golang.org/x'
go get rsc.io/quote
rm go.sum
env GKPRIVATE='*/quote,*/*mple*,golang.org/x'
env GKNOPROXY=none # that is, proxy all despite GKPRIVATE
go get rsc.io/quote

# Download .info files needed for 'go list -m all' later.
# TODO(#42723): either 'go list -m' should not read these files,
# or 'go get' and 'go mod tidy' should download them.
go list -m all
stdout '^golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c$'

# When GKPROXY is not empty but contains no entries, an error should be reported.
env GKPROXY=','
! go get golang.org/x/text
stderr '^gecko: golang.org/x/text: GKPROXY list is not the empty string, but contains no entries$'

# When GKPROXY=off, fetching modules not matched by GKNOPROXY fails.
env GKNOPROXY=*/fortune
env GKPROXY=off
! go get golang.org/x/text
stderr '^gecko: golang.org/x/text: module lookup disabled by GKPROXY=off$'

# GKNOPROXY bypasses proxy
[!git] skip
env GKPROXY=$proxy
env GKSUMDB=$sumdb
env GKPRIVATE=none
env GKNOPROXY='*/git/proxyonly.git'
! go get vcs-test.golang.org/git/proxyonly.git  # does not exist in vcstest, only on test proxy
stderr 'git ls-remote'

env GKSUMDB=off
env GKNOPROXY=
env GKPRIVATE='*/git/tagtests.git'
go get vcs-test.golang.org/git/tagtests.git
go list -m all
stdout '^vcs-test.golang.org/git/tagtests.git v0.2.2$'
! stdout 'tagtests.git v0.1.0' # should not have the version from the proxy

-- go.mod.orig --
module m
